subject: CONVERT function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-09 (PB59 family 5a), the static half: the ANUM-source screen keys on REPRESENTATION via the shared StaticUsageOf (usage display = alphanumeric characters), NOT on class - r5's NOTE ('distinct from simply requiring the string to be of class alphanumeric') cuts by what the storage HOLDS, so a numeric or edited DISPLAY item is admitted (the D9 corpus row pins CONVERT(WS-D ANUM ANUM HEX) of PIC 9(3) VALUE 5 -> 303035) while a COMP item (usage binary - not characters) and a NATIONAL item (national characters) are rejected with COBOL1514. The VALUE half - membership of the program's alphanumeric coded character set - is runtime territory and is total under the Annex A.1 item-33 identity correspondence, so no runtime case remains unreachable. The frozen 5a apply plan's class-based screen was corrected at apply time: a class screen would have rejected numeric DISPLAY items the rule text never forbids.
